releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.13 — faster tabs and a proper group chat. Switching between Chats, Groups, Status, History and Discover is now instant: the animated backdrop is static, tabs swap without a cross-fade, and lists no longer replay entrance animations every time you open them. Group chats now show who is typing by name (with the three-dot indicator) in the header and above the composer, and incoming group messages carry the sender's avatar on the first bubble of each run. Also ships eagle-x.md, the full project history and design notes.
